meta.name: chat-ui
meta.description: Chat UI building blocks for React/Next.js from ui.inference.sh. Components: container, messages, input, typing indicators, avatars. Capabilities: chat interfaces, message lists, input handling, streaming. Use for: building custom chat UIs, messaging interfaces, AI assistants. Triggers: chat ui, chat component, message list, chat input, shadcn chat,  react chat, chat interface, messaging ui, conversation ui, chat building blocks

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以生成 React/Next.js 聊天 UI 组件代码，包括容器、消息列表、输入框、打字指示器和头像。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 生成聊天界面、消息列表、聊天输入框或相关组件时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一个聊天容器组件。
say.note: Claude 会输出 ChatContainer 代码。

say.text: 创建一个带打字指示器的聊天界面。
say.note: Claude 会包含 TypingIndicator 组件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate React/Next.js chat UI component code, including container, messages, input, typing indicator, and avatars.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to generate chat interfaces, message lists, chat inputs, or related components.

say_en.text: Create a chat interface with a typing indicator.
